crisis.title: Need Immediate Crisis Support?
crisis.subtitle: You are never alone. Confidential, compassionate, and free support is available 24/7 across India.
crisis.teleManasDesc: National Tele Mental Health Programme of India (Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India). Free 24/7 support in 20+ Indian languages.
crisis.kiranDesc: 24/7 National mental health helpline operated by DEPwD for crisis counselling and mental health rehabilitation.
crisis.emergencyDesc: All-in-one national emergency helpline for immediate medical, police, or ambulance assistance.
crisis.warningBanner: If you are experiencing distress, thoughts of self-harm, or feeling overwhelmed, please connect with these verified free helplines right now.

assessments.disclaimer: MindSahaay assessments are educational screening tools and do not constitute a clinical diagnosis or medical evaluation. If you are experiencing distress, please reach out to campus counselling services or a qualified mental health professional.
assessments.phq4Desc: A 4-question screener measuring recent feelings of anxiety and low mood over the past 2 weeks.
assessments.phq9Desc: Standard 9-item questionnaire to help you track feelings of low mood, energy, and concentration.
assessments.gad7Desc: Standard 7-item questionnaire measuring patterns of nervousness and worry.
assessments.item9Alert: CRITICAL ALERT: Your response to Item 9 indicates thoughts of self-harm. MindSahaay has activated the student crisis protocol. Please connect with immediate professional support below.

consent.title: Student Data Privacy & Consent Ledger
consent.dpdpHeading: India Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 & Mental Healthcare Act 2017
consent.purposeDesc: Data collected is solely used for student mental well-being support and is never disclosed to campus administration, professors, or third parties without explicit revocable consent.
consent.cryptoDesc: Your journal entries are encrypted on your device using AES-256-GCM. MindSahaay servers only store encrypted ciphertext. No administrator or counsellor can read your journals.
consent.portabilityDesc: Students have the unconditional right to download a machine-readable JSON copy of all logged moods, assessments, appointments, and journals at any time.
consent.erasureTitle: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
consent.erasureDesc: Students can permanently wipe all local and remote data instantly without requiring administrative approval.
